title: Multiplayer, Permissions, Remote Sync & Recording/Streaming Boundaries
objective: Implement and prove deterministic non-authoritative multiplayer audio permission/synchronization and capture-boundary decisions over completed AAI-01..08 and canonical A5 authorization evidence, without creating gameplay/permission truth, performing remote transport or recording/streaming media, or widening provider rights.

canonical_permission_authority.rule: AAI-09 consumes canonical subject/session/permission decision references from the existing A5 authorization-before-projection seam and Visibility/Permissions owner references; it cannot grant, revoke, infer or mutate campaign/gameplay/identity/session/permission authority.

remote_sync.rule: Deterministic presentation-only remote-sync intents and receipts use stable sync identity, subject/session identity, monotonic sequence and caller-owned applied keys; duplicate/stale messages are suppressed and no network/provider/peer transport is performed.

capture_boundaries.rule: Recording and streaming remain separate explicit intents. Recording is capability-unmodeled/fail-closed because AAI-03 defines no recording capability key; streaming intent-ready requires independent AAI-02 rights, selectable AAI-03 capability, canonical permission and explicit participant consent. Intent-ready is not execution authority.

consent_privacy_security.rule: Consent is represented by stable references/scope/results only; raw consent text, credentials, tokens and media bytes are excluded from deterministic receipts.

persistence.result: No new durable canonical AAI-09 persistence; sync/permission/consent inputs remain caller/session-owned ephemeral state and deterministic receipts are evidence/projection only.

repair_history.failure_signature: AAI-09 client regression exposed non-total deterministic ordering when receipts shared primary sort keys.
repair_history.changed_evidence: Added requestId as the final deterministic tie-break for sync and capture receipt projections.

repair_history.failure_signature: AAI-09 client regression banned substring rawConsentText and therefore also rejected the explicit safe receipt field rawConsentTextStored:false.
repair_history.changed_evidence: Narrowed the regression to prohibit an actual rawConsentText serialized field while preserving explicit non-persistence evidence.

convergence_control.last_failure_signature: AAI-09 deterministic serialization regression conflated raw consent content with the explicit rawConsentTextStored:false safety marker.
diagnostic_hypotheses: The safety assertion was substring-based rather than checking for an actual rawConsentText field.
